tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall submit documentary evidence in support of the above qualification criteria. Tenders with all information and supporting documents by way of copies of work orders and audited Balance Sheets, including Profit & Loss Statement, Annual Turnover Statement, latest Income Tax Returns, etc. to establish their credentials and track record for fulfilling the experience.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
There shall not be any case or charge under investigation/enquiry/trial against the Tenderer or convicted in a Court of Law or suspended/blacklisted by any organization on any grounds.
KSPCB reserves the right to use in-house information for assessment of capability of Tenderer. The decision of KSPCB regarding the tender will be final and binding.

Tenderers are advised to visit the site during the office hours 10.30 am to 5.30 P.M to understand the nature and scope of the work. The tenderers may contact Mr. Sridhar S Malhari AEE (Procurement), for clarification.
Any agency/ contractor who quote less than the minimum prevailing wages or as per the payment of minimum wages act issued by the Labor department will be liable for Dis-qualification.
Minimum wages as per Labour Department norms & Part of ESI /PF etc., if any increase /Decrease in statutory levis will be borne by the Board.

The Agency shall arrange to pay EPF, ESI, and GST in respect of the persons deployed in KSPCB directly to the respective Government/Central Government Departments. In relation to EPF of the employees share and ESI be paid directly by Agency using their registered code. The concerned paid challans with applicable Certificates shall be furnished for verification to KSPCB along with the bills of succeeding month by Agency. Remittance of such amount is wholly the responsibility of the Agency. A copy of the receipt of EPF/ESI paid shall be given to the employees each month.
The wages for the man power shall be on par with minimum wages act.
For any clarification please contact the office of issue or contact Ph: 25581383 2589112
The quoted rates shall be of including GST.
Other terms and conditions as per Tender Document.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Satisfactory completion as prime contractor/Agency at least one similar works to an extent of 50 Percentage of the cost of the work i.e., Rs.15.38 Lakhs.
Tenderer should upload the copies of PAN and GST certificates.

The bidders shall submit the details of work done certificate issued for Annual Maintenance Contract for Electrical Installation, HT works, Lift Operations, AMC for HVAC & Diesel Generators sets handled by them in Government organization State or central/MNC/Public sector Since last three years as on date of submission of bids. Note- Work done certificate should be issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer
The Tenderer should possess Labor department registration details to be furnished.
The Tenderer should possess valid EPF and ESI Registration Certificate and details to be furnished.
The Tenderer should upload income tax returns, balance sheet and turnover for preceding five 5 years. 2021-22 to 2025-26
The Tenderers/Agency/firm should possess valid Class-I Electrical KPWD Registration Certificate/Electrical Inspectorate Registration details to be enclosed

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e 2021 22 to 2025 26. achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.30.76 Lakhs.
